tools.name: ask-codex
tools.description: Execute Codex CLI with file analysis (@syntax), skills ($syntax), model selection, and safety controls. Supports changeMode.

prompt.description: Task or question. Use @ to include files (e.g., '@largefile.ts explain').

model.description: Optional model override. Known: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5. If omitted, uses your Codex CLI default (~/.codex/config.toml). Specify only to override.

sandbox.description: Quick automation mode: enables workspace-write with approval=never. Sandboxing remains active.

fullAuto.description: Compatibility alias for workspace-write with approval=never (not --yolo)

approval.description: Deprecated alias for approvalPolicy — both map to --ask-for-approval. Prefer approvalPolicy. Values: on-request, never

changeMode.description: Return structured OLD/NEW edits for refactoring

image.description: Optional image file path(s) to include with the prompt

config.description: Configuration overrides as 'key=value' string or object

search.description: Enable web search using native --search flag (v0.52.0+). Requires network access - automatically sets sandbox to workspace-write if not specified.

oss.description: Use local Ollama server (convenience for -c model_provider=oss). Requires Ollama running locally. Automatically sets sandbox to workspace-write if not specified.

localProvider.description: Specify which local provider to use (lmstudio or ollama). Automatically enables --oss if not set. If omitted with --oss, uses config default or shows selection.

enableFeatures.description: Enable feature flags (repeatable). Equivalent to -c features.<name>=true

disableFeatures.description: Disable feature flags (repeatable). Equivalent to -c features.<name>=false

addDirs.description: Additional writable directories beyond workspace (e.g., ["/tmp", "/var/log"]). Useful for monorepos and multi-directory projects.

toolOutputTokenLimit.description: Maximum tokens for tool outputs (100-10,000). Controls response verbosity.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth. Omit to use the CLI default. max/ultra are model-dependent GPT-6/GPT-5.6 options; ultra may delegate to subagents.

sessionId.description: Session ID for conversation continuity. Enables native Codex resume.

resetSession.description: Clear session context before execution. Starts fresh conversation.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema path or inline schema to constrain output format (Codex CLI v0.95.0+)

personality.description: Communication style: pragmatic (concise, machine-friendly) or friendly (conversational). Codex CLI v0.94.0+

skipGitRepoCheck.description: Skip git repository validation. Useful for non-git directories (Codex CLI v0.75.0+)

outputLastMessage.description: Write final Codex message to file path. Useful for CI/CD result capture (Codex CLI v0.95.0+)

strictConfig.description: Fail when config.toml contains fields unknown to the installed Codex CLI

ephemeral.description: Run without persisting Codex session files to disk

ignoreUserConfig.description: Ignore $CODEX_HOME/config.toml for this run; authentication is still loaded

ignoreRules.description: Ignore user and project execpolicy .rules files for this run

bypassHookTrust.description: DANGEROUS: run enabled hooks without persisted hook trust

responseMode.description: Response verbosity: "clean" returns only the final answer (default), "full" returns the complete execution log including thinking, tool calls, and agent activity

tools.name: batch-codex
tools.description: Delegate multiple atomic tasks to Codex for batch processing. Ideal for repetitive operations, mass refactoring, and automated code transformations

tasks.description: Array of atomic tasks to delegate to Codex

model.description: Optional model override applied to every task. Known: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5. If omitted, uses your Codex CLI default (~/.codex/config.toml).

concurrency.description: Maximum parallel Codex processes when parallel=true. Default: min(task count, 4)

stopOnError.description: Stop execution if any task fails

timeout.description: Maximum execution time per task in milliseconds

search.description: Enable live web search for all tasks using the native --search flag

tools.name: review-changes
tools.description: Run a code review against the current repository using Codex CLI native review subcommand

prompt.description: Custom review instructions or focus areas (cannot be used with uncommitted=true; use base/commit review instead)

uncommitted.description: Review staged, unstaged, and untracked changes (working tree) - cannot be combined with custom prompt

base.description: Review changes against a specific base branch (e.g., "main", "develop")

commit.description: Review the changes introduced by a specific commit SHA

title.description: Optional title to display in the review summary

model.description: Optional model override. Known: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5. If omitted, uses your Codex CLI default (~/.codex/config.toml).

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth for the review. Default: high (code review benefits from deep reasoning).

workingDir.description: Working directory to run the review in (passed via -C as a global Codex option)

tools.name: brainstorm
tools.description: Generate creative ideas using structured frameworks with domain context and feasibility analysis.

model.description: Optional model override. Known: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5. If omitted, uses your Codex CLI default (~/.codex/config.toml).

fullAuto.description: Compatibility alias for workspace-write with approval=never

methodology.description: Framework: divergent, convergent, scamper, design-thinking, lateral, auto (default)

domain.description: Domain: software, business, creative, research, product, marketing, etc.

constraints.description: Limitations: budget, time, technical, legal, etc.

search.description: Enable live web search using the native --search flag

localProvider.description: Specify which local provider to use (lmstudio or ollama). Automatically enables --oss if not set.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth. Default: high (creative ideation benefits from depth). Override with "xhigh" for very complex domains, "medium" for quick exploration.

personality.description: Communication style: pragmatic (concise, machine-friendly) or friendly (conversational). Codex CLI v0.94.0+

tools.name: fetch-chunk
tools.description: Retrieves cached chunks from a changeMode response. Use this to get subsequent chunks after receiving a partial changeMode response.

cacheKey.description: The cache key provided in the initial changeMode response

tools.name: timeout-test
tools.description: Test timeout prevention by running for a specified duration

tools.name: list-sessions
tools.description: List all active conversation sessions with metadata, or manage sessions

action.description: Action: list (default), delete (single session), clear (all sessions)

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check Codex CLI and session health status

sessionId.description: Optional session ID to check specific session health

tools.name: list-skills
tools.description: Discover available Codex skills from .agents/skills/ directory

workingDir.description: Working directory to search for skills. Defaults to resolved working directory.

tools.name: do-act
tools.description: Execute task via Codex, verify with shell command, auto-fix on failure. Act-Check-Fix loop.

command.description: Shell command to verify result (e.g., "npm test", "cargo build")

verify.description: Shell command to validate result. Triggers act-check-fix loop on failure.

maxRetries.description: Max retry attempts if verify fails. Default: 2

model.description: Optional model override. Known: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5. If omitted, uses your Codex CLI default (~/.codex/config.toml).

fullAuto.description: Compatibility alias for workspace-write with approval=never

timeout.description: Codex timeout per attempt in ms. Default: 10min

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth. Default: high (act-check-fix loops benefit from depth so retries converge). Override with "xhigh" for hard tasks, "medium" for simple verifiable steps.

tools.name: image-gen
tools.description: Generate or edit images with Codex's built-in image_gen tool (ChatGPT login, no API key). Builds a structured prompt from use case, style, composition, exact text, reference roles and edit invariants, then returns the saved file paths. The image model and pixel size are chosen by Codex; aspect ratio and transparency are requested through the prompt.

prompt.description: What to create, or for edits, what to change. Be concrete about the subject.

editImage.description: Image to edit (absolute or relative to workingDir). Switches to edit mode.

preserve.description: Edit invariants, e.g. ["person and pose", "all text outside the sign"]

path.description: Image file path (absolute or relative to workingDir)

role.description: How the image model should use it: identity, style, logo, layout, subject, or general

references.description: Reference images with roles. Up to 5 images including editImage.

useCase.description: Task category from the Codex imagegen taxonomy; sets the polish level

assetType.description: Where the image will be used, e.g. "landing page hero", "app store screenshot"

style.description: Medium and style, e.g. "35mm film photo", "flat vector"

typography.description: Font style, size, color and placement for `text`

aspect.description: Aspect ratio: square, landscape (3:2), portrait (2:3), wide (16:9), tall (9:16), or W:H. Requested via the prompt; exact pixel size is chosen by Codex.

transparentBackground.description: Ask for a transparent (alpha) background; check `hasAlpha` in the result

presets.description: Guidance blocks: photoreal, portrait, likeness, product, thumbnail, no-text, exact-text, brand-style

enhance.description: Let the Codex host model enrich generic prompts with composition/lighting detail (never adds new subjects or text). false = pass the spec verbatim.

variants.description: Number of images; each is a separate image_gen call

outputPath.description: Copy results here (relative to workingDir). A path ending in / is a directory. Without it, images stay in $CODEX_HOME/generated_images.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing outputPath instead of writing a -v2 sibling

model.description: Host model that relays the call (not the image model). Known: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5. Omit to use the Codex default.

reasoningEffort.description: Host model reasoning. Default low: the host only relays the prepared spec.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms. Default 10 min; each image takes roughly 30-90s.
